name: tasks-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-tasks — the Tasks row inside the Workspace nav popover (hover-flyout task list, run-now), ported from aw-workspace-ui's hardcoded WorkspaceNav.jsx block and registered into the core.nav.workspace slot. src/client.js is the framework-free API client; src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
